scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix backend
scripts.start:local: npm run build:local && npm start --prefix backend
scripts.start:both: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build:local: cd frontend && npm run build -- --mode development
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build
